### A Little Help from Friends
Author: Melanie Chitwood
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragment-for-today-nov-23-2010-11641714.html
Passage: Exodus 17:12
Points:
- God never intended believers to carry stress, exhaustion, and heavy responsibilities alone.
- Even an anointed leader like Moses reached physical limits and suffered fatigue during prolonged battles.
- Complete victory over the enemy required Aaron and Hur to step in and support Moses' arms.
- God supplies faithful friends to sustain us through prayer, encouragement, and practical help.
- Overcoming pride and being vulnerable allows others to provide the strength we need to persevere.

### A Prayer for When You Are Losing Strength
Author: Rachael Adams
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-when-you-are-losing-strength.html
Passage: Exodus 17:12
Points:
- God consistently placed supportive companions in Moses' life to help him accomplish divine assignments.
- During the battle against the Amalekites, Moses relied on Aaron and Hur to keep his hands raised.
- When we pray for a struggling person to find strength, God may call us to be the solution.
- Believers are provided with natural support circles, including families, coworkers, and churches, to uplift one another.
- True Christian community requires actively stepping up to steady a weary neighbor until victory arrives.
